# Blog Post Preview

`editorial/blog-post-preview` &middot; section-level &middot; category: editorial

## Purpose

A compact post teaser: a small image beside the title, a short excerpt and a read link.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `article` | article |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Small image on the left.
- **image-right**: Small image on the right. Sets `imagePosition: right`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `imagePosition` | one of `left`, `right` | `"left"` |
| `linkLabel` | text | `"Read the post"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.md @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Side by side as a table row. | Fine. Stacks on phones through a media query. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('editorial/blog-post-preview', {
  "article": {
    "title": "Why we stopped using polyester thread",
    "excerpt": "A small change that makes every repair last longer.",
    "image": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/220x220/png?text=Thread",
      "alt": "Spools of natural cotton thread on a wooden shelf"
    },
    "href": "https://example.com/journal/thread",
    "category": "Materials"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "editorial/blog-post-preview",
  "data": {
    "article": {
      "title": "Why we stopped using polyester thread",
      "excerpt": "A small change that makes every repair last longer.",
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/220x220/png?text=Thread",
        "alt": "Spools of natural cotton thread on a wooden shelf"
      },
      "href": "https://example.com/journal/thread",
      "category": "Materials"
    }
  }
}
```
